svg.aria-label: F126.3.4 start, follow and stop a run: the interface design
svg.title: F126.3.4 start, follow and stop a run: the interface design

g.text: F126.3.4 start, follow and stop a run: the interface design
reads again every 3 s while running
a person's stop keeps the run as stopped
a shutdown leaves the file as it is

text.tspan: The judge hands back a mark with its cost and a turn keeps it. The rows carry the costs and the estimate. The desk can stop the run it plays. The web's client starts and stops a run for the card and the page. The number is the step; violet is there
